name: SYN-CLINNER-v1
description: Fully synthetic, template-generated clinical NER development dataset (BIO + character offsets).
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DATA. Not real patient data, not clinically validated, not a benchmark. Drug doses are illustrative and must not be used as clinical guidance.
offset_convention: character offsets into record['text'] (Python str indices), half-open [start, end)
normalization: normalized_name is a plain-text canonical string; normalization_status is always UNMAPPED_DEMO. No SNOMED CT / RxNorm / LOINC or other codes are included.

leakage_control.method: 13 sentence-template categories x 10 templates; templates 0-5 train, 6-7 validation, 8-9 test; each template is used by exactly one split
leakage_control.near_duplicate_rejection: candidate notes rejected if word-3gram Jaccard >= 0.55 with any accepted note (all splits)
